title: How the UK can win back financial competitiveness
summary: The report “The UK Financial Services Sector Has Lost Its Edge—Here’s How to Win It Back”, published by Boston Consulting Group (BCG), argues that while the UK financial sector retains global strength, it has been suffering from structural deterioration since the global financial crisis, which has weakened finance’s role as a driver of economic growth. Against this backdrop, lending to UK businesses has fallen to its lowest level in almost 30 years, standing at 59% of GDP in the third quarter of 2025, compared with close to 90% at the 2008 peak. BCG attributes this trend to a combination of excessive regulatory risk aversion, weak economic growth, technological underinvestment, and declining competitiveness compared to the US and Asia. The report sets out a broad range of concrete proposals to reposition the sector through AI, digital assets, and a new relationship between regulators and the financial sector.
